retrievalProfile.description: A retro layout featuring a framed photographic portrait offset against bold color blocks and heavy, condensed sans-serif typography.

recipe.visualDefinition: A multi-paneled composition with a dark maroon header, a large red field, and a yellow-framed rectangular portrait set against a vibrant blue background. The typography is characterized by ultra-condensed, blocky letterforms that dominate the upper third and right-hand column.
coreVisualRelationships: Primary portrait framed in yellow against a red field
Maroon header bar containing primary display text
Right-aligned tracklist column balancing the left-aligned portrait
High-contrast color blocking between red, yellow, and blue
coreInvariants: Thick yellow border around the central image
Asymmetrical distribution of text and image

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Portrait is positioned in the lower-left quadrant, occupying approximately 40% of the total area.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The yellow frame acts as the primary anchor, separating the subject from the red background.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the large white header text, move down to the portrait, then across to the right-aligned tracklist.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Large areas of solid red on the right and bottom provide breathing room for the dense typography.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep maroon header and bright yellow frame
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation across all primary fields with low-value maroon for grounding.

characterSpecificRedesigns: Uppercase 'L' with a very short horizontal arm
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface family used in varying weights and colors (white and yellow) to distinguish hierarchy.
graphicDevices: Small circular logos in top right corner

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the heavy, condensed verticality of the display text.
Matches the squared-off geometric feel of the mid-century era.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a layout with a dark maroon top bar and a bright red main field. Place a rectangular portrait of a person against a solid blue background in the lower-left, framed by a thick yellow border.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply ultra-condensed sans-serif text in white for the main title in the maroon bar. Add a vertical list of text in yellow on the right side of the red field.

verificationChecks: Is the portrait framed in yellow?
Is the header bar a distinct dark maroon?
Is the color palette limited to red, yellow, blue, and maroon?

adjustableVariables: Height of the maroon header bar
mustRedesign: Specific artist names and song titles

mustAchieve: Clear separation of image and text fields

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the yellow frame is thick and prominent
Verify the maroon header is present
Confirm the right-aligned text column is yellow
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine [Color Block Header] + [Framed Portrait Offset] + [Ultra-Condensed Sans-Serif] for a 1960s pop aesthetic.
